segments.text: Anthropic just accidentally leaked the entire source code for clawed code. It was exposed on npm and this backup repo is an absolute engineering gold mine.
Want to see exactly how top tier developers build flagship AI agents?
Look under the hood. It runs natively on Bun and uses React with Ink for a beautifully slick terminal UI. A rare look under the hood of a flagship AI product.
